segments.title: Cold Open & Network Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on with glitched audio; Case promotes Kickstarter follower goal (119 reached) and teases Saturday co-stream with John Madison.

segments.title: Pre-Show Chat, Cat Cam & Expert Calls
segments.notes: Case discusses cat cam, food apps, and Kickstarter; calls expert Bill Stern for stream-anniversary reenactment; calls expert Clive Clifton for campaign-promise bit.

segments.title: News Desk: Market Sell-Off & Midterm Aftermath
segments.notes: Case and Peter Gibbon cover $2.5T NASDAQ wipeout, AI bubble fears, Mississippi Senate race; Peter claims rats in every Senate building and offers wall-based stock visions; chat asks the wiki for a [[mr-smith|Mr. Smith]] page, Case thanks [[teflon-ted|Teflon Ted]], and Peter reads his [[bin-lore-wiki|BIN Lore wiki]] entry aloud.

segments.title: Election Night Reaction Compilation
segments.notes: Case and Peter watch Fox News election-night meltdown montage; mock Trey Gowdy's shine and horror novels; react to John Stewart demanding Schumer op-ed.

segments.title: Trey Gowdy & John Stewart Commentary
segments.notes: Extended discussion of Gowdy's appearance, 'Sound of Regret' book, Equinox locker-room sightings; Stewart clip on Schumer, seniority system, Democratic leadership.

segments.title: UPI Odd News: World Records
segments.notes: Dog clothespin record, 3-foot alligator in NC bagel shop, 11,578-lb rubber band ball in Michigan, British town crier Brenda Willison (loudest female shout, 39th anniversary).

segments.title: Full House Wardrobe Malfunction & Peter's Anatomy
segments.notes: Full House actress recalls guest star Brian Evans needing extra wardrobe; Peter volunteers his own 'stubby, outward, dimple-creating' penis details.

segments.title: Pete Hegseth Replacements & Russell Brand Conviction
segments.notes: Trump discussing Hegseth replacements; Russell Brand found guilty of one rape count and three sexual assault counts at Southwark Crown Court; Case retires Brand character.

segments.title: Joe Rogan Clip & Commentary
segments.notes: Case and Peter watch Rogan clip on social media echo chambers, phone addiction, fear manipulation; Case calls Rogan 'one of the dumbest people alive'; compare to Munch & Crum debate style.

segments.title: Rennerton Rebuild Planning
segments.notes: Case announces Valheim rebuild session tomorrow; explains mod barrier, seeks free alternatives like Palworld; mentions AI-generated Spyro hentai game attempt blocked by Claude.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Punch Rematch Debate
segments.notes: Skeleton Munch and Crum debate whether Crum gets a head or dick punch rematch; Crum chooses dick punch, describes hell-form fireball and detachable penis, reveals hell transit assistant-manager role, blames Matt Ladel sabotage, claims peen.ui data centers legally approved due to prior punch, admits Rennerton child-processing crimes, threatens to sue chat.

segments.title: Crum Home Invasion & Apology Tour
segments.notes: Crum physically enters Case's house uninvited; delivers rambling apology to women; Case ejects him; Crum threatens lawsuits over syllables and chat slander.

segments.title: Raid & Sign-Off
segments.notes: Case raids Steve's Ocarina of Time stream; reminds viewers of Patreon and tomorrow's Rennerton rebuild; ends No-Breaks-November broadcast.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a post-midterm broadcast covering a $2.5T NASDAQ sell-off, Fox News election-night meltdowns, and odd news including a clothespin world-record dog and an 11,578-pound rubber band ball. The Munch & Crum debate devolves into Crum relitigating the Crum Dick Punch, confessing to using zombie children as processing chips in Rennerton, and threatening to sue chat. Crum then physically breaks into Case's home to deliver a rambling apology to women before being ejected. The show ends with a raid on Steve's Ocarina of Time stream.
